title: Digital Product Design Intern
note: Digital UX/UI for in-vehicle screens, apps and web; ID majors also accepted.

facts.summary: UX/UI internship covering in-vehicle displays, companion apps and web. It is digital design, not physical product design.
facts.duties: Wireframes, flows and high-fidelity UI for vehicle screens and apps, plus design-system upkeep, engineering handoff and rider usability testing.
facts.requirements: Figma or similar tools and UX fundamentals. ID majors are explicitly welcome.
facts.apply: Apply through Polaris Workday. A portfolio showing UX process, such as flows and wireframes, is required.
